description: The boolean operators B-AND/B-OR/B-XOR/B-NOT (boolean expressions, ISO 8.7.2/8.8.2; COMPUTE Format 2 14.9.8; boolean relation 8.8.4.2.2; simple boolean condition 8.8.4.3). A COBOL-2002 introduction. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): ANSI X3.23-1985 has arithmetic operators only, §1985:VI.6.2.2: "There are five binary arithmetic operators and two unary arithmetic operators that may be used in arithmetic expressions" (+, -, *, /, ** and unary +, -), and no boolean data; §2002:F.1 item 6 ("The following reserved words have been added") lists B-AND, B-NOT, B-OR and B-XOR; §2002:8.7.2 adds "A boolean operator specifies the type of boolean operation to be performed on one or two operands", §2002:8.8.2 the boolean expression ("an identifier referencing a boolean data item", ...), §2002:14.8.7 "The COMPUTE statement assigns to one or more data items the value of an arithmetic or boolean expression", and §2002:F.2 item 8 states the change: "Boolean operations B-XOR, B-AND, B-OR, and B-NOT are provided for use in boolean expressions." §2014:8.7.2 / §2014:8.8.2 and §2023:8.7.2 / §2023:8.8.2 / §2023:14.9.8.1 / §2023:8.8.4.3.1 ("A boolean condition determines whether a boolean expression is true or false") carry the 2002 text. The operator tiers are {is2002()}?-gated, so below 2002 the W1.5 parse-layer mapping names the edition (0900) and the words are user-defined. (Depends on boolean data - the source uses PIC 1 items.)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. BOOLOP1.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-A PIC 1(4) VALUE B"1100".
01 WS-B PIC 1(4) VALUE B"0101".
01 WS-R PIC 1(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    COMPUTE WS-R = WS-A B-AND WS-B.
    DISPLAY WS-R.
    STOP RUN.
